title: Ecology federal permits record: Killough PRF System Replacement (Aquatics 140795)

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: Replace an existing timber pier, ramp, and float (PRF) system with a new fully grated PRF system. The existing PRF system consists of a 624 square foot (SF) timber pier, 105 SF timber ramp, and a 330 SF timber float with an associated 24 SF ramp landing float. The existing PRF is supported by 12 creosote piles which would be removed.
